title: Switchyard gateway configuration (gateway.yaml)
description: Configuration of the Switchyard LLM gateway. `${VAR}` and `${VAR:-default}` are replaced from the environment before validation. Reference: docs/CONFIG.md.

request_timeout_ms.description: Hard cap for one request, streams included.

shutdown_grace_ms.description: How long SIGTERM waits for in-flight requests to drain.

redis.description: Redis (optional; without it everything is in-memory, per process).

url.description: Redis 8 URL. Enables shared limits, budgets, caches, breakers and the usage stream.

fail_open.description: Admit requests when Redis is unreachable (rate limits / budgets are skipped, logged).

connect_timeout_ms.description: Connect timeout of the Redis clients.

database.description: Postgres (optional; required for database keys, budgets and usage reports).

url.description: Postgres URL. Enables database keys/teams/budgets, the usage ledger and the admin API.

admin_token.description: Bearer token of the admin API (`SWITCHYARD_ADMIN_TOKEN`); admin API is off when unset.

static_keys.description: Keys defined in config (bootstrap/dev/CI); database keys are the normal path.

key.description: The key, ≥ 12 characters (use `${ENV}`); entries with an empty key are skipped with a warning.

team.description: Team slug the key belongs to.

name.description: Label used in logs and usage reports.

allowed_routes.description: Route names this key may call; omitted = all routes.

allow_direct_models.description: Allow calling `models:` entries directly by name (not only routes).

rpm.description: Requests per minute for this key.

tpm.description: Tokens per minute for this key.

key_cache_ttl_s.description: TTL of the Redis key-record cache (DB keys). Revocation is pushed via pub/sub.

local_key_cache_ttl_ms.description: TTL of the per-process key cache in front of Redis.

pricing_file.description: Path to the pricing table (relative to the config file).

window_s.description: Rolling window for the failure rate.

min_requests.description: Minimum requests in the window before the failure rate can trip the breaker.

failure_rate.description: Failure rate (0..1) that opens the breaker.

consecutive_failures.description: Consecutive failures that open the breaker regardless of the rate.

cooldown_s.description: First open period; doubles on every re-trip.

attempts.description: Total attempts per target (1 = no retry).

backoff_ms.description: Base delay of exponential backoff with full jitter.

max_retry_after_ms.description: Upper bound for honoring upstream Retry-After.

type.description: Bridge to an `opencode serve` instance (e.g. GitHub Copilot models).

enabled.description: Set false to disable the provider (and its models).

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent upstream requests for this provider (0 = unlimited).

queue_timeout_ms.description: How long a request may wait for a concurrency slot before failing with `upstream_busy`.

username.description: Basic-auth user of the opencode server.

agent.description: opencode agent used for every session (should have all built-in tools disabled).

session_title.description: Title prefix of the (always deleted) per-request sessions.

streaming.description: `events`: true streaming via opencode's /event SSE; `synthetic`: await then chunk.

repair_attempts.description: Max repair round-trips for emulated tool calls / JSON mode.

temperature_models.description: Models that accept temperature/top_p (others have these params dropped).

type.description: Any OpenAI-compatible server: llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, Groq, OpenRouter, …

enabled.description: Set false to disable the provider (and its models).

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent upstream requests for this provider (0 = unlimited).

queue_timeout_ms.description: How long a request may wait for a concurrency slot before failing with `upstream_busy`.

base_url.description: API base URL including `/v1` (models may override it).

api_key.description: Bearer token, if the server needs one.

supports_tools.description: Whether the upstream supports native `tools` (llama.cpp with --jinja does).

enabled.description: Set false to disable the provider (and its models).

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent upstream requests for this provider (0 = unlimited).

queue_timeout_ms.description: How long a request may wait for a concurrency slot before failing with `upstream_busy`.

enabled_if_key.description: Disable this provider automatically when `api_key` is empty.

type.description: Anthropic Messages API (translated from/to OpenAI shape).

enabled.description: Set false to disable the provider (and its models).

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent upstream requests for this provider (0 = unlimited).

queue_timeout_ms.description: How long a request may wait for a concurrency slot before failing with `upstream_busy`.

default_max_tokens.description: `max_tokens` is mandatory for Anthropic; used when neither request nor route sets one.

enabled_if_key.description: Disable this provider automatically when `api_key` is empty.

enabled.description: Set false to disable the provider (and its models).

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent upstream requests for this provider (0 = unlimited).

queue_timeout_ms.description: How long a request may wait for a concurrency slot before failing with `upstream_busy`.

allow_header_faults.description: Honor `x-mock-*` request headers for fault injection (never enable in production).

fixed_text.default: This is a fixed response from the Switchyard mock provider.

extractive_threshold.description: Minimum lexical overlap for mock-extractive to answer instead of NO_ANSWER.

scripts.description: Scripted tool-call responses for `mock-tools`, keyed by script id.

faults.description: Faults applied to every request of this provider.

status.description: HTTP status used for injected failures (always fails when set and fail_rate is 0).

stream_fail_after.description: Fail a stream after emitting N content chunks.

type.description: Your own adapter, registered via `createGateway({ adapterFactories })`.

enabled.description: Set false to disable the provider (and its models).

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent upstream requests for this provider (0 = unlimited).

queue_timeout_ms.description: How long a request may wait for a concurrency slot before failing with `upstream_busy`.

factory.description: Key in `createGateway({ adapterFactories })`; defaults to the provider name.

options.description: Free-form settings handed to the factory unchanged.

providers.description: Upstream connections, by name. Discriminated by `type`.

kind.description: What the model serves; routes may only mix models of one kind.

base_url.description: Per-model base URL override (llama.cpp serves one model per port).

input_templates.description: Embedding templates selected by the request's `input_type`; `{text}` and `{title}` are replaced.

output.description: USD per 1M output tokens (reasoning tokens are billed as output).

cached_input.description: USD per 1M cached input tokens (defaults to `input`).

per_request.description: Flat USD fee per request (e.g. rerank searches).

pricing.description: Model pricing (USD per 1M tokens). Overrides the pricing_file entry.

context_window.description: Context window, used for pre-flight estimates only.

params.description: Request body defaults merged under the client request (OpenAI-family upstreams).

targets.description: Models this route dispatches to (in fallback order for `fallback`).

strategy.description: How targets are ordered per request.

retry.description: Overrides the top-level `retry` for this route.

attempts.description: Total attempts per target (1 = no retry).

backoff_ms.description: Base delay of exponential backoff with full jitter.

max_retry_after_ms.description: Upper bound for honoring upstream Retry-After.

timeout_ms.description: Total deadline for the whole request across retries and fallbacks.

exact.description: Exact-match cache for deterministic requests (temperature unset/0, n ≤ 1).

enabled.description: Set false to disable without removing the TTL.

semantic.description: Semantic cache on Redis 8 vector sets (needs Redis; requests without tools only).

enabled.description: Turn the semantic cache on for this route.

embed_route.description: Embedding route used to embed the prompt.

min_similarity.description: Cosine similarity needed for a semantic hit.

shared.description: Share entries across teams (default: namespaced per team).

defaults.description: Request parameters applied when the client does not set them.

anyOf.description: Reasoning effort hint, mapped per provider (dropped where unsupported).

max_tokens.description: Default `max_tokens`; also bounds the pre-flight cost estimate.

routes.description: Virtual models exposed to clients: the `model` field of every request.

defaults.description: Limits for keys and teams that set none themselves.

window_s.description: Sliding-window length; RPM/TPM are defined per window (keep at 60).

enforcement.description: `hard` blocks with 402, `soft` only alerts, `off` disables budgets.

soft_threshold.description: Utilization that fires the soft alert (budgets may override).

alert_webhook.description: URL that receives budget alerts as JSON (one attempt, deduplicated).

reconcile_interval_s.description: How often the worker reconciles Redis spend counters from Postgres rollups.

definitions_ttl_ms.description: TTL of the per-process cache of team budget definitions.

stream.description: Redis stream that carries usage events.

retention_days.description: Monthly usage partitions older than this are dropped.

in_process_writer.description: Run the usage worker inside the gateway process (single-node setups).

buffer_max.description: Events kept in memory while Redis is unavailable; older events are dropped beyond this.

consumer_group.description: Redis consumer group of the workers.

claim_idle_ms.description: Pending entries idle longer than this are reclaimed (XAUTOCLAIM) from dead consumers.

partitions_ahead.description: Monthly partitions created ahead of time.

port.description: Serve /metrics on a separate port (e.g. 9464) instead of the API port.

log_bodies.description: Reserved: prompt/response body logging is not implemented yet.

metrics.description: Legacy switch; metrics are on only when this and `metrics.enabled` are true.

otel.description: Reserved: OpenTelemetry tracing is not implemented yet.

interpolated.description: A value taken from the environment: `${VAR}`, `${VAR:-default}` or `${VAR-default}`.
